card.name: Verbs of continuing or keeping a state
card.fires_on: Verbs about something staying the same or being prolonged, such as kept, stay, stayed, perpetuate and persisting, in opinion or news prose. Also fires on a sentence-opening "We" in a threat.

modes.label: Staying or prolonging
modes.description: Verbs meaning a state continues or is kept in place, often with a negative situation.
modes.example: Public concern has<< kept>> the plants offline despite increasingly strident warnings

modes.label: Perpetuate and persist
modes.description: The start or middle of perpetuate or persisting.
modes.example: But that would simply<< perpet>>uate the cycle of devaluing work

modes.label: Quoted threat
modes.description: A sentence-opening "We" in a quoted threat.
modes.example: the argument becomes a threat: "<<We>>'ll just sell it to the Chinese

card.writes: It pushes toward words of completion or change (freed, perfected, redesign) and away from words of loss or retention.
card.plain: It marks verbs about a situation lasting or being kept as it is, such as kept, stay or perpetuate.
